tasks.author: ai-task-writer-f
tasks.prompt: Summarise the rules an entity name must follow in the catalog, including how names may change over time.

rubric.text: By default a name is 1 to 63 characters of [a-zA-Z0-9] sequences separated by one of - _ or . (the ruleset is configurable; non-conforming entities are rejected).
Names must be unique per kind within a namespace, at any point in time.
The uniqueness check is case insensitive.
A name may be reused after the entity holding it is deleted.
Do not rename an entity while other entities still reference it, since references resolve by name and would break.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-f
tasks.prompt: Compare the length and content restrictions on label keys, label values and annotation values for catalog entities.

rubric.text: A label key has an optional prefix that must be a lowercase domain name of at most 253 characters, and the backstage.io/ prefix is reserved for Backstage core.
The name part of a label key is required, is sequences of [a-zA-Z0-9] separated by - _ or ., and is at most 63 characters.
Label values follow the same restrictions as entity names (1 to 63 characters of the name character set).
Annotation keys follow label key rules, but annotation values have no length limit; they must be strings.

tasks.notes: Cross-section: labels, annotations and name sections.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-f
tasks.prompt: Which lines must change to raise the default maximum length of an entity name from 63 to 100 characters?
tasks.notes: Label key name parts (63) are a separate limit and should not change; label values inherit the name rule by reference, so their line needs no edit.
